spans.s:
मिण्डलिन्, इ, इनी, इ, forming a circle or ring,
made up into a coil or ball; possessing or ruling a
country; (ई), m. ‘marked with round spots,’ a par-
ticular kind of snake (= गो-नास); ‘ringed,’ any
snake; the ruler of a district or province; a pole-cat;
a cat; a dog; the Indian fig-tree [cf. मण्डल-
वट]; the sun.

मिण्मिण मिण्मिण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking
indistinctly through the nose.
